name: Omnikom Platform
offer: Researches and scores a local business's presence in search and AI answers, builds its website from an approved SEO plan and design, hosts it, and gives one sign-in to the Omnikom CRM (every lead from the website) and the dashboard (edit and publish the site, photos, settings)
audience: Local businesses: the business owner and their team members
notOffer: Not a white-label tool, no automatic push of leads to a client's CRM, and no SMS or email to leads, bookings, payments, AI concierge or ads until the owner unparks them

constraints: Client-facing claims are never invented: no fake reviews, results, licences or numbers
Nothing is promised to clients until a paid tier
No white label: every site and mail says powered by Omnikom
